info.title: Infoblox NIOS WAPI
info.description:
Infoblox NIOS Web API (WAPI) provides comprehensive programmatic access to DNS, DHCP, and IPAM resources managed by Infoblox NIOS appliances.

Authentication: HTTP Basic — NIOS administrator username and password. Enable API access under Grid → Grid Manager → Members → API Settings.

Source: https://docs.infoblox.com/space/niosapireference
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 102 of 321 upstream operations covering common CRUD for automation: core DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, HOST, MX, NS, PTR, SRV, TXT), Networks, Network Containers, Network Views, Ranges, Fixed Addresses, Leases, Grid, Members, Extensible Attribute Definitions, and Authoritative Zones. See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.
